source.prompt: Melodic uplifting trance song, about 3.5 minutes, 136 BPM, C# minor. Euphoric, open-sky, sunrise-over-the-ocean mood, emotional and soaring. Clear, airy female lead vocal with soft stacked harmonies on the chorus. Lush string section pads, smooth supersaw-style chord swells, gentle pizzicato string arpeggio, soft piano in the breakdown, warm rolling offbeat bass. Driving four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hats, claps on 2 and 4, light ride cymbal in the drops, snare-roll builds. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal, piano and strings, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end, smooth lead sounds.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Ooh, ooh

[Verse]
Morning breaks over the water line
Gold on the sails and the salt in my mind
I left my fear on the edge of the shore
Now I can feel what my heart was made for

[Pre-Chorus]
Higher, higher, nothing holds me down
Every heartbeat lifts me off the ground

[Chorus]
Brighter than gravity, I'm rising with you
Out past the clouds where the sky turns to blue
Hold me, we're flying, the world falling free
Brighter than gravity, you and me

[Verse]
Wind in my hair and the sun on my face
Your hand in mine and we're losing all space
The stars we chased are behind us tonight
We are the spark, we are lighter than light

[Pre-Chorus]
Higher, higher, nothing holds me down
Every heartbeat lifts me off the ground

[Chorus]
Brighter than gravity, I'm rising with you
Out past the clouds where the sky turns to blue
Hold me, we're flying, the world falling free
Brighter than gravity, you and me

[Bridge]
Ooh, let it go, let it go
Ooh, the light is all I know

[Chorus]
Brighter than gravity, I'm rising with you
Out past the clouds where the sky turns to blue
Hold me, we're flying, the world falling free
Brighter than gravity, you and me
